description: This file is a JavaScript module that implements a minimal API client wrapper around the fetch() API for a web application. It manages authentication tokens via localStorage, constructs API request URLs, handles headers, processes responses, and provides a health check endpoint function.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl()
methods.description: Returns the base URL for the backend, defaulting to same-origin if environment variable is not set.

methods.name: getToken()
methods.description: Retrieves the stored authentication token from localStorage.

methods.name: setToken(token)
methods.description: Stores or removes the authentication token in localStorage.

methods.name: clearToken()
methods.description: Removes the authentication token from localStorage.

methods.name: apiRequest(path, { method = "GET", body, headers } = {})
methods.description: Performs an API request to the specified path with given options, handling authentication headers, response parsing, and error throwing.

methods.name: healthCheck()
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the root endpoint '/' to verify backend health.

ctags.name: apiRequest
ctags.pattern: /^export async function apiRequest(path, { method = "GET", body, headers } = {}) {$/
